## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally.
- [ ] The change follows the existing code structure and style.
- [ ] New config options have defaults and comments, and new messages are added to the language files.
- [ ] Permissions, commands, and placeholders are registered and documented where applicable.
- [ ] New modules are registered, shipped disabled by default, and added to the README module list.
- [ ] Public API changes are additive, or breaking changes are described below.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or server-specific data are included.
- [ ] I have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/Bruderjulian/SunLight-spigot#-requirements) (if any).
